theme_core.description: Sleek dark, futuristic, and adaptive. A calm neutral base that shifts its visual mood (accents, background textures, fonts) based on the configured agent's persona.

backgrounds.dynamic_mesh: Use framer-motion or standard CSS radial gradients that shift position and color based on active persona.
backgrounds.overlays: When using background images, ALWAYS apply a bg-zinc-950/80 overlay to preserve text readability.

agent_builder_form.style: Glassmorphism panels floating over the dynamic background.
agent_builder_form.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 focus:border-[var(--theme-accent)] rounded-none px-0 py-2 text-lg focus:ring-0 transition-colors
agent_builder_form.dropdowns: CRITICAL: Dropdown menus MUST have a solid background (bg-zinc-900 border border-white/10), NEVER transparent. Use Shadcn Select/Dropdown.
agent_builder_form.smart_suggestions: Small chips below inputs using mono font, glowing slightly on hover.

template_cards.style: Image backgrounds with heavy black/80 overlay. On hover, image scales up 105% and overlay lightens slightly to black/60.
template_cards.interactions: Reveal 'Use Template' CTA on hover using Framer Motion.

chat_interface.ai_message: Sleek typography, left-aligned, accompanied by a subtle glowing vertical line on the left indicating the AI's current persona accent.
chat_interface.user_message: Right-aligned, soft bg-white/5 rounded-2xl px-6 py-4.
chat_interface.proactive_guidance: Floating 'Step-Ahead' widget in bottom right or directly below the latest AI response. Styled as a solid elevated surface with a shimmering border.

layouts.dashboard: Mobile-first CSS grid. Use generous spacing (gap-8, p-8, p-12). Avoid edge-to-edge content on desktop.
layouts.builder_split_view: Desktop: Grid 12 cols. Left 5 cols for Form, right 7 cols for Live Chat Preview.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up slightly (opacity 0 -> 1, y: 10 -> 0).
motion.theme_shift: When persona changes, transition all colors and gradients over 1000ms ease-in-out.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on buttons should scale up slightly (1.02) and brighten text.

images.rules: Never use placeholder images. Use heavy overlays (bg-zinc-950/70) to ensure text contrast.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Text over images must use text-shadow or heavy background overlays.
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--theme-accent)] for all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

3d_libraries_and_media.strategy: Use Framer Motion for UI transitions. For background effects, standard CSS or lightweight Canvas is preferred over full Three.js to keep the builder snappy, unless specifically rendering a 3D avatar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a global state (e.g., Zustand or Context) to track the 'active_persona'. Bind CSS variables (--theme-accent, --theme-glow) to this state so the entire app shifts color dynamically.
Use Tailwind arbitrary values `bg-[var(--theme-accent)]` where dynamic theming is required.
Ensure all Shadcn UI dropdowns, select menus, and dialogs have a solid dark background (`bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800`). Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for overlays.
Use `Outfit` for all headings, `IBM Plex Sans` for body text, and `JetBrains Mono` for form labels, config keys, and smart suggestion chips.
Avoid generic Vercel/Stripe aesthetics. Make it feel cinematic and highly personalized.
For the Google Login button, style it sleekly with a subtle border and glowing hover effect, avoiding the generic white default button.
Do not use generic font families like Inter or Roboto.
Do not apply global `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors`, `transition-opacity`.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent uses placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
